name: Pharmaceutical manufacturing

problems.words: Distributors send back near-expiry stock and claim full credit
quick_ideas: Check each return's batch against your dispatch records before approving — confirms it was yours
Put your returns policy in writing to all distributors — removes argument.

workzap_build.text: a returns and credit-claim workflow with batch checks before approval.

problems.free_stops: The approval rules and checks are in the solution document.

problems.words: I don't know which batch is lying with which distributor
quick_ideas: Note batch numbers on every dispatch to distributors — builds the trail
Ask distributors for their stock by batch once — gives a starting picture.

workzap_build.text: a batch-to-distributor dispatch register so any batch can be located quickly.

problems.ask_first: How many distributors do you work with?
problems.free_stops: The register design is in the solution document.

problems.words: Expired stock write-offs are huge at year end
quick_ideas: List stock by expiry month across your warehouse — shows what's at risk next
Dispatch oldest batches first — reduces stock left to expire.

workzap_build.text: a near-expiry monitor by distributor and batch that flags stock months before expiry.

problems.ask_first: Do distributors share stock by batch with you?
problems.free_stops: The alert timing is in the solution document.

problems.words: API imports stuck at port, a product is short in the market
quick_ideas: Work out cover in days for each imported input — shows which could stop production next
Get a weekly status of every open consignment from your clearing agent — no surprises.

problems.free_stops: Cover levels and tracked stages are in the solution document.

problems.words: Medical reps report doctor visits but I can't verify any of it
quick_ideas: Compare reps' reported visits with secondary sales in their areas — shows where activity doesn't match results
Review sample issue against visits — highlights gaps.

problems.free_stops: The reporting format and manager views are in the solution document.

problems.words: Distributors pay late and keep pushing returns to offset balances
quick_ideas: Separate returns from payments on each distributor's statement — makes the real balance visible
Settle returns only after they're checked — stops offsets you haven't agreed.

workzap_build.text: a distributor ledger with ageing, approved returns and automatic reminders.

problems.ask_first: Which distributors are slowest to pay?
problems.free_stops: The ledger and reminder rules are in the solution document.

problems.words: Registration renewals are in an Excel nobody updates
quick_ideas: Put every renewal date on one calendar with an owner — nothing is forgotten
Collect the documents for the next few in one folder — saves the last-minute rush.

problems.words: Sales data from distributors comes late and in different formats
quick_ideas: Send all distributors one standard sheet to fill — makes figures comparable
Fix a date each month for submission — gets data sooner.

workzap_build.text: distributor secondary-sales uploads merged into one report by product and region.

never_say: No medical, dosing, formulation, stability or clinical advice; never say a product is safe or effective.
No advice on DRAP, MOHAP/EDE or Health Canada rules, registration strategy or pricing law.
Adverse reactions or patient harm: urge medical care and emergency services, suggest the regulator's reporting channel, record nothing clinical.
Never help sell unregistered or expired products, relabel batches, change expiry dates or make fake documents; decline.
Never help design improper doctor incentives or divert controlled substances.
No patient, doctor or chemist names or numbers; roles and towns only.

sample_reply.person: Is ka koi solution hai? Distributors near-expiry stock wapas bhej ke poora credit maangte hain aur humein batch ka pata hi nahi hota.
sample_reply.pi: Ji, bilkul hai, aur shuruaat isi hafte ho sakti hai. 1) Har dispatch par batch number note karein, taake wapsi par check ho sake ke batch aap ka tha. 2) Returns policy likhit mein sab distributors ko bhej dein, taake credit par behes kam ho. Workzap yeh aap ke liye khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: batch-to-distributor register aur near-expiry alerts, jo har return ko approve hone se pehle check kar lein. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
